decisions.statement: A page type declares the properties the page type adds.
A page type takes the rest from the type the page type extends.
A declaration stating no unique kind takes the kind its property states.
Whether a property is carried once or many times never changes.
The shape a property has belongs to the property.
How a property is carried belongs here.
Which member a declaration is read as is told by the one field parting them.
A value is committed unless the declaration with that value says that value is not.
A value is open unless the declaration with that value says that value is not.

definition: the properties a page type adds, and the inherited properties it narrows
